$comment: Pinned security-scanner versions for the DevSecOps control plane. Owner: D3 (dwight). digest_sha256 = manifest-list digest of the immutable base ref declared in tool/scanner/images/<name>/Dockerfile (verified against live registries 2026-08-26); derived worker-image digests get recorded at first packaging build. Never retag in place - rebuilds produce a new tag via PR bump. Bump policy: quarterly review by D3; security-critical bumps ad hoc.

policy.pinning: exact version tags AND base-image digest pins before any production scan workload

tools.name: semgrep
tools.purpose: Static analysis of application code (SAST rulesets).

tools.name: gitleaks
tools.purpose: Secret/credential detection in repos and diffs.

tools.name: trivy
tools.purpose: SCA: dependency, container-image and IaC vulnerability scanning.

tools.name: wpscan

packaging.note: built from ruby base + 'gem install wpscan -v 3.8.28'; no public upstream image exists at this version (hub wpscanteam/wpscan stops at 3.8.18)

tools.purpose: WordPress core/plugin/theme vulnerability correlation from centrally collected version inventory — never heavyweight scanning on live hosts.

tools.name: lynis

packaging.note: CISOfy release tarball pinned by sha256 in Dockerfile ARG; no public cisofy image registry reachable (hub+ghcr both absent)

tools.purpose: OS/host hardening audit on central/staging hosts under approved maintenance procedures only.

tools.name: testssl.sh

packaging.note: '3.2' is upstream's rolling rc-line tag; the digest pin is the immutability authority here

tools.purpose: External TLS/network posture checks against managed endpoints.

tools.name: zap
tools.purpose: DAST against staging environments only — ZAP staging is explicitly D3-owned; never pointed at production.

tools.name: phpcs-wpcs

packaging.note: will follow the wpscan source-build pattern (composer/composer.lock pin) when introduced in Section 5

tools.purpose: PHP_CodeSniffer + WordPress Coding Standards for WP code review pipeline. Pinned when introduced (build plan Section 5).

tools.name: wp-vuln-intel

packaging.note: internal advisory-correlation engine (rules detector); no container image. Bundles a curated WP vuln advisory fixture; superseded by the live WPScan API when WPSCAN_API_TOKEN is set (see docs/wp-vuln-intel.md)

tools.purpose: Correlate WordPress core/plugin/theme versions (kevin S10-D4 inventory) against WPScan/advisory intelligence; emit CVE findings + fixed-version + update-risk.
